sentences.en: I've always loved the freedom that comes from being introverted.
sentences.zh: 我总是喜欢内向带来的自由。

sentences.en: Introverts need solitude to recover from having to work with extroverts.
sentences.zh: 内向的人需要独处来恢复精力。

sentences.en: Introverts often find it difficult to make new friends.
sentences.zh: 内向的人常常发现交新朋友很难。
